title: Federal Withholding Election on Income Annuities Commuted Value Lump Sums
content:
Federal tax on a commuted value lump sum paid on an Ashgrove Income Annuities contract is withheld at the rate the beneficiary chose on the commutation election when the election carries one; when it carries none and the payee is a beneficiary other than the owner, at the lump-sum default rate of **10% (0.10)**. In any other case neither of these rates applies.

The election read is the latest approved commutation election on the contract. A rate chosen on it, including a chosen rate of 0%, is a rate the election carries.

| Rate carried on the latest approved election | Payee | Federal withholding rate |
|---|---|---|
| 20% | Any | 20% |
| 0% | Any | 0% |
| None | Beneficiary other than the owner | 10% |
| None | The owner | Neither rate applies |

*Hypothetical figure.* Taxable part $41,323.78: at a chosen 20% the federal tax is $8,264.76; with no rate on the election and a non-owner beneficiary, $4,132.38 at 10%.
